Subject: POC trial environment setup  hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC

Thanks again for your time this morning  great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC/trial so we can lock timelines and ownership.

Summary of options we discussed:
- Hosted trial (Redwood hosted API): fastest to spin up, minimal infra changes, good for functional/quality validation.
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity): predictable throughput for realistic load tests, per-customer isolation.
- VPC trial (customer VPC or VPC peering): required for regulated data/workloads, private networking and KMS integration.

What we need from Acme to finalize scope and timeline:
1) Success criteria (latency, throughput, quality targets, cost limits).
2) Preferred environment (hosted -> quickest; VPC -> if you need private networking; dedicated sandbox -> middle ground).
3) Any security/compliance blockers (KMS, SSO, data residency, IP allowlists).

Proposed evaluation plan (draft):
- Week 0: Kickoff + finalize success criteria and sign trial agreement.
- Week 1: Environment provisioning and smoke tests.
- Week 2: Functional validation & sample workload run.
- Week 3: Load test + quality evaluation and decision.

Ownership (proposed):
- Redwoods lead: me (Marissa)  overall project owner and timeline.
- Infra/SE: Nikhil Sharma  VPC and network setup, dedicated sandbox sizing.
- Onboarding/CS: Monica Patel  test plan, success metrics, evaluation tracking.

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (checklist + required items for provisioning).

Next steps: can you confirm success criteria and which environment you prefer by end of day Friday? Once confirmed well schedule kickoff and send a short trial agreement for signature.

Thanks  Marissa

--
Marissa Cole

marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: POC trial environment setup  hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC

Thanks Marissa  appreciate the clear plan. A few notes from our side after internal sync: 

- Preferred environment: Wed like to pursue a VPC trial (private) because the initial dataset contains client PII and our security team prefers no egress. That said, were open to a quick hosted smoke test in parallel if it speeds validation.

- Success criteria (initial draft):
  * Latency: 95th percentile generation < 200ms for typical short prompts (~60 tokens).
  * Throughput: sustain 100 infer requests/sec (concurrency profile attached) for 15 minutes during load tests.
  * Quality: sample eval set (30 prompts) must meet/reach baseline accuracy and reduce hallucination rate compared to current baseline.
  * Cost target: keep average per-token spend within agreed budget (well provide a target range).

- Security asks: KMS integration for key management, SSO via Okta, and an initial list of required IP ranges for peering.

Timeline: were targeting a decision by mid-March (approx 3 weeks). If we can kickoff next week, that should work.

Ill loop in our infra lead if we move forward. For now, can you have Nikhil outline the VPC prerequisites and an estimated provisioning timeline? Also please send the trial agreement for legal to review.

Samir

Hi Samir / Marissa  quick technical note on VPC onboarding and dedicated sandbox option.

VPC onboarding prerequisites (high level):
- VPC peering or AWS PrivateLink configuration (we support both; peering is fastest).
- CIDR allowlist required on your side; well provide a short list of outbound IPs for flows and health checks.
- IAM roles: a service account with permissions to create ENIs and route tables (if using Terraform automation).
- KMS: provide Key ARN and us-east-1 KMS policy access (we can also support customer-managed HSM via partner).
- SSO: Okta SAML + SCIM details; provide admin contact and SP metadata.

Estimated timelines: 
- Hosted trial: provision in < 24 hours  best for quick functional validation.
- Dedicated sandbox: 213 business days to reserve capacity and configure access.
- VPC trial: 317 business days depending on approvals and our network team window. 

Required items from Acme to start:
1) CIDR ranges to peer and a contact for network engineering (IP and Slack handle).
2) Okta admin contact for SSO setup.
3) KMS ARN if you want to encrypt keys on your side.

Ive attached a short vpc-onboarding-checklist.md with the exact fields well need. If you want, I can share a Terraform snippet to speed provisioning.

Nikhil
